title: Plant Breeders' Rights record - Cargo
summary: Canadian plant breeders' rights record for Cargo, naming David M. Brazelton and Adam L. Wagner as breeders.
why_it_matters: Canadian plant breeders' rights examination reports are among the very few publicly available descriptions of a blueberry cultivar that are produced by an independent examiner from a replicated comparative trial with a named location and season. They are therefore the strongest available counterweight to owner trait claims, even though the descriptors are ordinal rather than numeric.

reading.rationale: The closest thing to independent trial data available in the public record.

testing.rationale: Provides a named protocol and comparison standards that a trial design can reuse.

commercial_position.rationale: Rights coverage in Canada is a secondary commercial signal.
